title: Space Exploration Quiz
description: Journey through the universe and test your space knowledge!

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun! It's also the smallest planet in our Solar System. ☀️

questions.question: Which is the biggest planet in our Solar System?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is so huge that all the other planets could fit inside it! It also has a giant storm called the Great Red Spot. 🪐

questions.question: What is the name of our galaxy?
questions.explanation: We live in the Milky Way galaxy! It has over 100 billion stars, and our Sun is just one of them. 🌌

questions.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red because of rusty dust on its surface! Scientists think it may have had liquid water billions of years ago. 🔴

questions.question: How long does it take light to travel from the Sun to Earth?
questions.explanation: Light travels incredibly fast – 300,000 km per second – but the Sun is still so far away it takes about 8 minutes! ⚡

questions.question: What is a shooting star actually made of?
questions.explanation: Shooting stars are actually small rocks called meteors that burn up as they enter Earth's atmosphere. They're not stars at all! 🌠

questions.question: Which planet has rings around it?
questions.explanation: All four outer gas planets have rings, but Saturn's rings are the biggest and most beautiful – made of ice and rock! 💍
